objectives: Reteach weak /b/ components identified by diagnostic evidence.
Reassess /b/ recognition, decoding, encoding, comprehension, and fluency with fresh items.
Route the learner to advancement or another targeted reteach cycle.
concepts: Remediation should target the demonstrated weak component.
Fresh assessment items provide a cleaner reassessment signal.
Mastery requires both threshold performance and adequate critical-component performance.
Comprehension and fluency remain part of phonics consolidation.

definitions.definition: Focused instruction and practice for a specific skill component identified as weak.
A fresh measurement after remediation used to determine whether mastery has been reached.
A new assessment item testing the same skill without repeating the prior diagnostic item.

workedExamples: If /b/ versus /p/ is weak, practise listening and identifying the two sounds before decoding.
If short-vowel encoding is weak, segment CVC words and map each phoneme to a grapheme.
If comprehension is weak, reread controlled text and answer using explicit evidence.
If fluency is weak, reread accurately with phrasing and then check meaning.
commonMistakes: Repeating the same diagnostic items instead of using fresh evidence.
Practising a strong component while ignoring the weak one.
Advancing because of speed despite inaccurate reading.
Advancing despite a critical comprehension gap.
keyTakeaways: Advance only after mastery criteria are met.

basic: Identify /b/ in initial and final word positions.
conceptual: Distinguish /b/ from similar consonants and short-vowel spellings.
application: Choose the correct remediation response for a learner error.
Use controlled sentences and passages to verify understanding.
higherOrderThinking: Interpret reassessment evidence and decide whether to advance or reteach.
mixedReview: Combine sound recognition, decoding, encoding, comprehension, and fluency.

quickRevision: hear → identify → blend → spell → understand → read smoothly
formulaOrFactBank: Advance = overall score >= 0.80 AND no critical component below target.
mistakeBasedRevision: If an error persists, identify the exact component before selecting the next practice.
weakTopicRevision: Reteach only the component(s) below target, then reassess with fresh items.

outcomes: Learner demonstrates fresh evidence of /b/ consolidation.
System routes the learner to advancement or another targeted remediation cycle.

decision.advance: Advance when reassessment score is at least 0.80 and no critical component remains below target.
decision.reteach: Reteach the specific component(s) that remain below target and reassess again with fresh items.
